reviews.text: I took my dog ​​for a grooming session, which was excellently done by the sales assistant Lucia Lamura, who then helped me purchase a bunny.

I went to Zoomiguana in San Marcellino in the aquarium department. Antonio C served me, as he wrote on the card. He was a very kind young man, super helpful and kind, very knowledgeable, he gave me all the explanations I needed, highly recommended.

I just visited the Zoomiguana store in Mirabella Eclano. The way they keep animals is disgusting.
Guinea pigs without a drop of water in the dispensers. I was speechless. When I asked an employee to give them water, he arrogantly replied that they know when to do it.
Leaving animals like this isn't neglect, it's abuse. If this is your idea of ​​animal care, you should change your job.
I will never set foot in this store again, and I urge anyone who cares about animals to do the same. I will report this to the local veterinary health authority and the relevant authorities, because situations like this should not be tolerated.
Shameful.

On September 23rd, I needed some products for my aquarium, and on my way home from work, it was 8:30 PM when I entered the shop. Usually, when you enter a shop, especially in shopping centers, at closing time, the salespeople look at you a little askance because they want to close up and go home after a day's work. Instead, I want to congratulate everyone who works in this wonderful place, but above all I must praise the salesperson named Nayla for her hospitality, reliability, friendliness, and professionalism in carrying out her work. She looked after me from the moment I entered until the moment I left, advising me on everything I needed in an excellent manner. Congratulations on the prices because they are truly unbeatable, and the quality and cleanliness of the place. Congratulations again, Nayla.

Lots of items, but at decidedly high prices.
I realize that a business has high running costs, but overdoing it with boxes and accessories is definitely NOT a good idea.
Well-stocked and professional
Hi David, thanks so much for your review. See you soon!
Well stocked
Hi Ottaviano, thanks so much for your review. See you soon!
Hi Francesco, thanks so much for your review. See you soon!

At the San Marcellino headquarters, I THANK AND PRAISE the very talented Antonio (the youngest one) of the aquarium department, together we created a splendid 180 liters purchased and configured directly by him, I being a novice he had the patience and the right advice to ensure that my aquarium is beautiful
Okay.
Terrible, zero support, even worse purchasing advice

Thank God, there's a central store in Naples, on Via Santa Brigida. I went this morning and received assistance: Ms. Giovanna guided me through the purchase of the necessary products for my new dog, I must say with great expertise and kindness. Thank you for everything.

Special thanks to Antonio Piccolo of the Marcianise shop, who guided me step by step through the setup of my aquarium, providing expert advice on both choosing the right fish and proper water maintenance.

Thanks to Michele from the aquarium department, whose advice solved my water heating problem during this extremely hot period. I also purchased fans for my 80-liter tank.
Thanks also to Carmen, who, despite the fact that it was just minutes before closing time, allowed me to make the purchase, pay, and save my little fish.
Super top!
Hi, thanks so much for your review. See you soon from Zoomiguana!
Hi Antonio, thank you so much for your review. We look forward to seeing you again soon at Zoomiguana!
Well stocked with exotic animals also stocked with excellent pet food
Find everything you need for your pet...dog, cat, hamster, rabbit, bird, reptile
Kind and well-mannered

I'm rewriting my review here because I went to the wrong store before! Beautiful place, well-stocked, and the staff is truly top-notch compared to other stores. The only downside, guys, is that the air conditioning isn't working again this year. Please, it's impossible to choose items while sweating! It's too hot, even for pets! A manager said it should have been fixed last year. Please!

The guys were very kind. I'm speechless about the grooming service. I dropped off a Cavalier King Spaniel, asking them to shave his belly, remove the undercoat, and trim him a bit. They gave me back I don't know what. The top was clipped, with the sides wide open. The chest was trimmed in steps, and under the belly, the hair was long and already dirty. The first photo shows the before, with shiny, long fur, just as it should be. The other shows the job done. The dog will now be shedding for months, and his coat will be harsh and dull.

A very negative experience. During my visit to the Zoomiguana store on Via Crispi, I found the air conditioning turned off and the inside felt excessively hot and suffocating. The situation was particularly critical in the aquarium department on the lower floor, where it was virtually impossible to linger for more than a few minutes due to the high temperatures.

What concerns me most is that there are numerous live animals in the store, even on the first floor. In a facility that houses animals, I would expect constant temperature control to ensure adequate conditions for their well-being, as well as for the comfort of customers.

I hope management will act quickly to resolve the problem. A situation like this, especially in the warmer months, should not occur.

Hi Mario,
Thank you so much for your review. We look forward to seeing you again soon at Zoomiguana!
Knowledgeable and kind cashier

Hi Peppe,
Thank you so much for your review. If there's anything we can do to earn a fifth star, please let us know. We look forward to seeing you again soon at Zoomiguana!

Excellent grooming service. I brought my dog ​​the other day, and Fabrizio was really good at untangling all the knots and even taking care of my dog! Thanks to the super-friendly girl at the register who introduced me to this department too! I'll definitely be back...

Samuel really helped me out in a moment of need. He went above and beyond to make sure the right brand of food was delivered to my place personally, since I couldn’t pick it up after the weekend. Without his help, my pet would have gone too long without his daily food. Thank you so much 🙏 …
Excellent reference for satisfying my cat, Katia's kindness and her precious advice helped me a lot.
This shop on Via Crispi is large and very well stocked. The staff is helpful and friendly. Recommended.

I bought a hamster from this store, and unfortunately, it was a very negative experience.

After a few days, I discovered that my pet was completely infested with red mites. At first, I thought it was just itching, but when I got home, I noticed numerous parasites both on him and in his cage. The situation quickly worsened: the hamster became weak to the point of near-death.

Furthermore, his home environment was also infested with hundreds of mites, creating a serious problem to manage.

During my visit to the store, I had already noticed other animals scratching themselves frequently, which now makes me suspect poor hygiene practices.

I strongly recommend paying close attention before purchasing animals from this store.

I took my toy poodle to the grooming department at Zoomiguana in Mirabella Eclano (AV), and I must say the experience was truly excellent.

I had the pleasure of meeting Fabrizio there: polite, professional, and very knowledgeable about his work. You can immediately see the passion and care he devotes to animals.

The result? My poodle left looking like a real teddy bear, soft and cared for like a stuffed animal! 🐶✨

I highly recommend this service to anyone who wants the best for their four-legged friend.
Number 1s in everything

The grooming service, provided by Mr. Fabrizio, was excellent; he also went out of his way to give me excellent advice on grooming.
He was kind and helpful, and I highly recommend him.

Terrible experience.....
We went to ZOOMIGUANA in Trani on Sunday, March 22nd, where we purchased a hamster, a cage, and a litter box.
When we got home, we put the hamster in the cage.
The next day, I noticed that the closet was infested with small black worms, and when I looked, I noticed they were coming out of the litter box. I called the store and they told me to go and get a replacement.
From Corato, I went to Trani; they sent me to the first floor and, once they saw the worms, they replaced the litter box.
I got to the checkout and couldn't change it because they told me I needed a receipt, not even if I'd bought it a month ago...there are cameras.
In short, I left empty-handed...
I could have changed it even without a receipt...
Never again...

I visited the Quarto Megastore in the aquarium department. I was served by Alessio, if I'm not mistaken, a true professional and aquarium expert. You notice that immediately after 20 years of aquariums. He's kind, knowledgeable, and helpful.
Too expensive compared to other pet shops
Purchased some parrots from the shop in Via Foibe, Bari. The expertise and advice given by Mr Massimo were very much appreciated.
Professional and welcoming staff
I had a great experience, I bought a lop rabbit, and it is healthy thanks to the shop assistants who explained to me how to treat and maintain a rabbit.

I was at the Marcianise store. The manager, Giorgio, made me wait about twenty minutes to come to the checkout for a bill. The staff was unprofessional and criticized the quality of some products on the shelves.

I found a beautiful, welcoming shop, well-stocked with everything. The staff was very helpful and patient.
I highly recommend it.

Hi Anna Maria,
Thank you so much for your review. If you have any suggestions for earning us a fifth star, please let us know. See you soon!
Kindness and speed

Terrible experience, we called to get information on certain animals, without being told that the animals could not be purchased at the time, without our knowledge, after a 40 minute drive we arrived and were told that we cannot buy them.
I find it cruel to keep animals locked in cages. Animals die and suffer because of your cruelty.

I have been a customer for some time, an excellent shop, but I would especially like to praise Giuseppe the Groomer, a fantastic person in every way, polite, friendly and above all very professional, thank you.

Hi Christian,
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We're so happy you had a positive experience at Zoomiguana. We look forward to seeing you in store soon, so we can continue to share our world of animals with you, with passion, expertise, and a focus on their well-being.

The friendly and professional staff provided me with all the information I needed to purchase the right tropical fish and the right care tips. I'll definitely be back to buy more and get valuable advice.

Today, after a year, I returned to this beautiful shop. I met Mr. Massimo again, and this time too, he convinced me with his advice and experience to buy a monk parakeet with a beautiful cage. I recommend everyone to try it and ask for Mr. Massimo.

I was supposed to give my Lagotto Romagnolo a bath today at the Casoria branch, booked online from 1 to 2 pm. I arrived there after taking time off from work and without lunch at 12:55 and the groomer told me that there was no reservation because booking on the website is not enough, but you need his confirmation. Either write this in capital letters before making the reservation or don't allow it. This is seriousness. Thank you for making me lose 4 hours of work, lunch and still having my Joy to wash. Congratulations

Hi Paolo,
Thank you so much for your review. We look forward to seeing you again soon at Zoomiguana!

Today I went to the store on Via Santa Brigida, as I've been doing for months... given that I recently got a puppy, I was assisted with a purchase by a sales assistant named Marica, who, in addition to being professional, was incredibly sweet and empathetic. WELL DONE!

Hi Antonio,
Thank you so much for your review! We look forward to seeing you soon at Zoomiguana!
Beautiful. Well-kept. Well-stocked. Excellent customer service.
Mariarca is an empathetic and very good person who immediately understands what you need.
Professionalism and kindness... I couldn't ask for more for washing my dogs.

We've been to the Bari Santa Caterina store several times. It was an excellent experience. We're especially grateful to Massimo for his expertise, kindness, and sensitivity. He helped us choose our Cocoriti budgies and provided valuable care advice.

Hi Fernando,
Thank you so much for your review. We look forward to seeing you again soon!
Excellent shop where you can find everything you need for our animal friends
Very friendly staff

I bought a Maine Coon cat in January 2025, almost a year has passed. The only characteristic of the breed is its tail. I took it to several experts, and they described it as a Norwegian forest cat. I complained to them after just two months, and they're just stalling. I'll be forced to hire a lawyer. A terrible experience, and they're making a terrible impression.
I'll answer your question: your consultant, who has never seen my cat except in photos, simply tells me to wait... It's true about the hair pills. Is that what you call a consultation? I, on the other hand, went to expert vets, three to be precise... who see, measure, and weigh the cat, and I disagree with your consultant... who doesn't even have a degree... and who just stalls... plus, I already have a Maine Coon at home... and even a blind person could see that they are two completely different cats. In any case, since you don't intend to resolve the matter... I'll contact a lawyer.
Every time I go there I always find prices higher than average...

Good morning, this is the second time I've come to pick up canaries that cost me €30 each. I got a pair of curly-haired ones, both male and not a pair. On Saturday I got a canary that was supposed to be female, but instead I got a male. I definitely won't be coming to this shop again! I have to go to San Felice and I'm canceling Marcianise after paying €30 for a canary, and I also have to pay for gas. Please assign someone to the canaries who can determine whether they are male or female. After your reply, I wanted to tell you that it's difficult to tell the sex of newly hatched canaries, but the one I bought is from 2023!

It is therefore unheard of that a store with such a high customer base and such a large number of animal species, even today, months later, during a period that is still so hot, STILL HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO ADDRESS THE AIR CONDITIONING FAILURE. This situation is extremely uncomfortable for customers, who are unable to linger longer than strictly necessary, unless they opt to visit other similar stores. Furthermore, this condition is DANGEROUS for their physical health (creating an environment fertile for viruses and bacteria) and psychological health, stressing the animals, who already live in a temporary environment despite the staff's constant attention to cleanliness and comfort. At the end of July, I already reported this disrespectful situation to the manager, who kindly informed me that they had already reported the fault in a timely manner and to the appropriate authorities. Before any more serious complaints can be filed, I urge the appropriate authorities to take swift action to remedy this situation. I WOULD LIKE TO POINT OUT THAT IT IS ONLY FOR THIS PRIMARY REASON THAT I AM HERE TO GIVE A NEGATIVE REVIEW OF THIS STORE, OF WHICH I HAVE BEEN A FULL CUSTOMER FOR AT LEAST 7 YEARS.
The nicest guys. Such a big store and Alessandro went out of his way to help us. He was so patient with my terrible attempts at Italian. Grazie Mille!

I'm a regular customer at the shop on Via Crispi.
All the employees are friendly and helpful, especially Remo, who, thanks to his experience and advice, helped me first with the care and now with the various stages of reproduction of my Pantherophis guttata, which has just given birth to 5 little snakes.
Highly recommended!
I occasionally shop at the store on Via Crispi, and all the staff are courteous and knowledgeable. Remo, in particular, strikes me as truly knowledgeable and passionate.

Hi Miki,
Thank you so much for your review! See you soon!
I purchased two Montana cages Madeira III aviaries on the advice of Massimo, a knowledgeable and incredibly kind person. Simply the BEST!!!

I went to the Trentola store and an employee helped me buy some things, but when I got to the checkout, the price of everything he had magically sold me was no longer the same. On the receipt, I found myself marked down for an extra purchase, as well as a few extra euros that I don't know what calculator they use... And on top of that, by the time I got home, two fish had died. First and last time there!!!!
Super stocked.

Hi Ransilu,
Thanks for your review. See you soon!

Very large and well-stocked center, certainly being a large distribution center you expect more competitive prices in fact looking at the cans of wet food for dogs they cost 20/30 cents more, I looked at the seeds for parrots but I found 0.60 cents more than what I pay in my country sincerely to improve in this aspect

Hi Lorenzo,
Thanks for your review! See you soon!

Hi Alessandro,
Thanks for your review. See you soon!

Hi Gianpaolo,
thank you for your positive review. See you soon!

Hi Giuseppe,
Thanks for your positive review! We look forward to seeing you in store soon!

Clean, welcoming, and well-stocked megastore
Highly qualified staff
The reptile manager, Mr. REMO, is impeccable, competent, patient, and always available. Highly qualified, congratulations.
Thanks to all the staff and thank you for the quality and for creating a small kingdom, or rather, a suitable animal habitat.
We purchased a monk parakeet and a rabbit from the Santa Caterina (BA) store, following the advice of the legendary Massimo, who is professional and always available. We were extremely satisfied.
Thank you Zoomiguana on behalf of all animals (not just fish)

I went on a trip to Naples and went into this shop hoping to buy my dog ​​a souvenir, but to my surprise (it's illegal in Spain) I saw they were selling cats and dogs. The dogs and cats were in tiny cubicles and were in terrible condition. There was a skinny poodle lying on the floor that, frankly, looked dead (not just asleep). A Pomeranian also had a sad face…horrible. I left without buying anything, of course. I don't give money to people who sell animals.
A place where I can find everything that makes my little and big friends happy ❤️

I've been to the Vomero branch and now I can't live without it. Thanks to them, I discovered a passion for aquariums, and thanks to the department staff, I'm learning quickly. The staff are highly qualified and helpful; we've developed a friendship, and I thank them for everything. Highly recommended.

Zoomiguana Vomero: Truly rude and unspeakable staff. When the goods arrive for unloading, they illegally occupy the sidewalk with pallets of incoming goods. When we pointed out that pedestrian access isn't guaranteed, my family and I were attacked by the employee.

Hi Giovanni,
We're happy to hear you enjoyed your visit. We always strive to offer the best service to our customers. We look forward to seeing you in store again soon!

Hi Pasquale,
Thank you for sharing your review with us. We're sorry to see 3 out of 5 stars. If you have any suggestions for improvement, please email us at customercare@zoomiguana.it. See you next time!

A somewhat disappointing experience at Zoomiguana Casoria! I bought a new fish for my marine aquarium after consulting with the staff. Upon arrival,
the fish was attacked by the others. The next day I called and was told there was nothing they could do... "He'll get used to it"! His tail fin was already bitten off. How are you supposed to get used to it?! It cost €30, but I called to find a solution! In the end, I took it to the Caserta/Marcianise store and gave it as a gift... as soon as they saw it, they told me... "This fish wants to be territorial!!! He'll put himself in the tank!!!!"
Disappointing!
